newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells up on P&O deal prospects.
newsitem.headline: John Keells up on P&O deal prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka's John Keells Holdings (JKH) rose 5.6 percent or 10 rupees to 190 rupees on Thursday on foreign buying after news that its joint venture with P&O had signed a huge port deal, brokers said.
"There is a lot of buying interest on the expectation that the P&O deal will boost JKH's earnings," said a local broker who declined to be identified.
Brokers said 100,000 shares were traded and a further 42,500 were on bid at 190.25 rupees.
Sri Lanka has signed a deal with South Asia Gateway Terminals, a joint venture between Britain's P&O and John Keells to expand facilities at Colombo port at a cost of $1.0 billion.
